documents.title: Inspection circuit / service card
body: Local inspection circuit. Compare the identifier on this card with the marked service front before requesting a check.
Open complaint: weak exterior inspection light. The observatory receiver is a separate system. This card is not an instruction to change receiver calibration.
The permitted service check has a visible response at the marked inspection light. Compare the completed panel result with that response. File an uncertain result as uncertain.
documents.production_nb: Fiktivt servicekort ved trygg betjeningsfront utenfor avsperrede høyspentdeler. Ikke tegn dette som en virkelig elektrisk koblingsinstruks.

documents.title: Inspection card / completed local check
body: Completed local service check: panel result and inspection light agreed after the ordinary complaint was handled.
Completion date and time: recorded from the actual check. Observed response retained with the service result.
This establishes the result of that check at that time. It is not a continuous record of every circuit throughout the night.
documents.production_nb: Bare gis etter ctx_trafo_service_ok. Adapteren påfører faktisk lokal dato og klokkeslett; feltet er ikke en fast 20:xx-gjetning.

documents.title: Inspection card / later disagreement
body: Reference position matched against the retained field sheet. Local isolation checked; backup explanation excluded under the permitted control; panel indication compared against the independent service result.
The marked light continued its visible sequence. The result and the observation did not agree under these controls.
Cause unknown. Keep this with the normal inspection card and the reference sheet. Do not write a source or a distance that was not measured.
documents.production_nb: Bare etter alle fire faktiske T02-verdensbetingelser. Tilføy faktisk dato/klokkeslett og eget referansebilde ved lagring; aldri automatisk ved avspilling av VHS.
